name: fluxplace — KiCad engineering suite
description: Signal-flow placement, routing, DFM and fab packaging for KiCad 10 — placement, autorouting, comprehension, sourcing and a manufacturer upload package for PCBWay and JLCPCB, end to end, gated by the packaging rules.
description_full:
fluxplace is a full PCB engineering suite for KiCad 10, not just a placer. It reads the board's communication graph (power/ground excluded so they do not tie everything together), places components so routing falls out as a tree, runs a placement tournament judged by a real router, pours and stitches planes, launders copper against DRC, patches walled islands with rip-up-and-reroute, checks every MPN against live DigiKey/Mouser stock before a part reaches copper, and emits the manufacturer upload package (gerbers, drill, centroid, BOM, assembly instructions, order worksheet).

Packaging and update features:
- Packaging-rules gate (P1-P8): a package is not 'ready' unless all eight rules pass; deliver prints one PASS/FAIL line per rule.
- Fab sets for PCBWay AND JLCPCB: BOM and CPL in each house's format, DNP parts excluded, every part with an LCSC pick or marked consigned.
- Delivery for a new version of an existing delivery: previous BOM fields and DNP lines carried, assembly text carried, README-FIRST with what changed and known-open status, review folder, renders, datasheets, KiCad project.
- review, fab and deliver accept --baseline PREV: fail only on new findings, inherited ones are listed.
- spec-sync: schematic is the electrical truth, board fields are the part truth.
- Limit research: numeric limits are graded against sourced hard limits; over the hard limit is FAIL, between target and hard limit is WARN.
- Fab-house conformance: sub-minimum features are fixed, or written as per-house order options.

REQUIRES KiCad 10.0 or newer (pcbnew + kicad-cli). Several capabilities need components pip cannot install: Java and the freerouting 2.3.0+ jar for routing, LibreOffice for the PDF upload slot, and DigiKey/Mouser API credentials for the availability gate. On first run the plugin checks every requirement and offers to install the python packages for you; `fluxplace doctor` does the same from the CLI.
